SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-27-2015 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE AND TO OBTAIN A SPANISH INTERPRETER FOR JUAN MORALES TO MAY-19-2015 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. THE PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO DMA CLAIMS, INC. BY COURT AT SMALL CLAIM HEARING OF MAY-19-2015 AT 3:30 PM.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-19-2015 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-19-2015 BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FOR DEFENDANT DMA CLAIMS INC. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT EXCEPT DEFENDANT DMA CLAIMS INC. WHO WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE HEARING TODAY. DEFENDANT WAS ASSISTED BY SPANISH INTERPRETER--CRISTINA VISUS. THE INTERPRETER'S IDENTIFICATION HAS BEEN VERIFIED, VIA EMPLOYEE BADGE OR OTHER DOCUMENTATION PROVING CERTIFICATION OR REGISTRATION AND PHOTO IDENTIFICATION. THE INTERPRETER HAS AN OATH ON FILE WITH THE COURT. PLAINTIFFS EXHIBITS RETAINED. DEFENDANTS EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-19-2015 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TUYAKBAYEV, DANIYAR RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MORALES, JUAN GARCIA $2,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $65.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,065.00, THE COURT FINDS THAT RESPONSIBILITY IS SHARED BETWEEN PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT BUT DEFENDANT HAD MORE RESPONSIBILITY DUE TO HIS RATE OF SPEED AND THAT HE HAD THE LAST CHANCE TO AVOID THE IMPACT. PARTIAL PROPERTY DAMAGES ARE AWARDED TO PLAINTIFF. LOST WAGES ARE DENIED AS TOO SPECULATIVE. DEFENDANT DMA CLAIMS INC. IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AT REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF FOR FAILURE TO SERVE.
